newsitem.title: UK: LME copper, other metals steady in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper, other metals steady in late trading.

text.p: Copper and other base metals hung on to their gains in late inter-office trading on Monday after a day of strong rallies.
London Metal Exchange (LME) three months copper was bid at $2,408 per tonne at 1900 GMT, unchanged from the afternoon kerb close.
Aluminium was down just $1 at $1,689, and nickel and zinc were also virtually unchanged.
News that workers at Russia's Norilsk Nickel complex had adopted a strike plan fuelled Monday's rally in nickel and sparked upside moves in the other metals.
The market was awaiting Tuesday's LME stocks report for further direction, with drawdowns expected in both copper and aluminium, analysts said.
